summary: The docs pass before the item-doors merge into runtime2. All eight brief items are written against the code and decisions 300-320: what a prompt guards, the app folder's .data/, how the gate judges a link, a signed value that arrives, the bin-to-a-tty line, the N18 stale names, the CLAUDE.md proposals, and the good_to_know rules. Documentation, CLAUDE.md, one script and one build-file comment only: no production C#, no .pr, no os/system teaching markdown (so no re-pin).

changes.description: What the prompts guard (the User actor, not the app's own code; consent from the actor's input only); .data/ line; Where a verb is judged (Location/Spot, move source read+delete, grant on the place, trailing separator, folder-link delete, file as a tree of one, ask once check all, anchors landed once, unpack links, LinkLoop); Authorize flow and file map brought to the code.

A signed value that arrives: nonce presented once per arrival after hash and signature; verifies and names its signer any number of times, copies too; same bytes again is NonceReplay; stored read is not an arrival. The line saying Read does not verify corrected.
The read's verify step points at the one nonce presentation per arrival.
One line on %!app.channel.setting.format% and bin to a tty (H).
Anchors are paths (N18); Own settings and identity keys section; three limits rows.
N18: AbsolutePath/OsDirectory line removed; filesystem line.
Same stale class as N18, not on the brief's list: the flag rule stated as it is; refused forms replaced.
Index: four topic docs and eight section lines for the rules from decisions 300-319.
Proposals 1, 3, 4, 5, 6 applied; N18's anchors line and Debugging section.
CHANGELOG entry for the user-visible changes, and the file-by-file table.
